mapper.select: select current_logistics.logistics_id, current_logistics.tenant_id, current_logistics.member_id, current_logistics.order_id, current_logistics.direction, current_logistics.order_no, current_logistics.carrier, current_logistics.tracking_no, current_logistics.route_status, current_logistics.abnormal_flag, current_logistics.route_available, current_logistics.route_provider, current_logistics.route_message, current_logistics.route_query_time, current_logistics.recipient_phone, current_logistics.destination_address from ( /* 原订单列表会优先展示已接受子订单的物流，轨迹查询必须使用同一条记录。 */ select child_logistics.logistics_id, child_logistics.tenant_id, child_logistics.member_id, child_logistics.order_id, child_logistics.direction, child_order.order_no, child_logistics.carrier, child_logistics.tracking_no, child_logistics.route_status, child_logistics.abnormal_flag, child_logistics.route_available, child_logistics.route_provider, child_logistics.route_message, child_logistics.route_query_time, child_order.recipient_phone, case when child_logistics.direction = 2 then child_warehouse.address else child_order.recipient_address end as destination_address, 0 as priority, child_logistics.create_time from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order child_logistics inner join ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance alliance_link on alliance_link.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and alliance_link.source_member_id = #{memberId} and alliance_link.source_order_id = #{orderId} and alliance_link.child_order_id = child_logistics.order_id and alliance_link.target_member_id = child_logistics.member_id and alliance_link.child_order_id is not null and alliance_link.is_delete = 0 inner join ry_business.ry_rental_order child_order on child_order.tenant_id = child_logistics.tenant_id and child_order.member_id = child_logistics.member_id and child_order.order_id = child_logistics.order_id and child_order.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_warehouse child_warehouse on child_warehouse.tenant_id = child_logistics.tenant_id and child_warehouse.member_id = child_logistics.member_id and child_warehouse.warehouse_id = coalesce(child_logistics.warehouse_id, case when child_logistics.direction = 2 then child_order.return_warehouse_id else child_order.warehouse_id end) and child_warehouse.is_delete = 0 where child_logistics.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and child_logistics.direction = #{direction} and child_logistics.is_delete = 0 union all select own_logistics.logistics_id, own_logistics.tenant_id, own_logistics.member_id, own_logistics.order_id, own_logistics.direction, own_order.order_no, own_logistics.carrier, own_logistics.tracking_no, own_logistics.route_status, own_logistics.abnormal_flag, own_logistics.route_available, own_logistics.route_provider, own_logistics.route_message, own_logistics.route_query_time, own_order.recipient_phone, case when own_logistics.direction = 2 then own_warehouse.address else own_order.recipient_address end as destination_address, 1 as priority, own_logistics.create_time from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order own_logistics inner join ry_business.ry_rental_order own_order on own_order.tenant_id = own_logistics.tenant_id and own_order.member_id = own_logistics.member_id and own_order.order_id = own_logistics.order_id and own_order.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_warehouse own_warehouse on own_warehouse.tenant_id = own_logistics.tenant_id and own_warehouse.member_id = own_logistics.member_id and own_warehouse.warehouse_id = coalesce(own_logistics.warehouse_id, case when own_logistics.direction = 2 then own_order.return_warehouse_id else own_order.warehouse_id end) and own_warehouse.is_delete = 0 where own_logistics.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and own_logistics.member_id = #{memberId} and own_logistics.order_id = #{orderId} and own_logistics.direction = #{direction} and own_logistics.is_delete = 0 ) current_logistics order by current_logistics.priority, current_logistics.create_time desc, current_logistics.logistics_id desc limit 1

select r.route_id, r.logistics_id, r.tracking_no, r.route_status, r.route_desc, r.route_time, r.province, r.city, r.raw_json, r.create_time from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_route r inner join ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order l on l.logistics_id = r.logistics_id and l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and l.member_id = #{memberId} and l.is_delete = 0 where r.logistics_id = #{logisticsId} and r.is_delete = 0 order by r.route_time desc, r.route_id desc

select l.logistics_id, l.tenant_id, l.member_id, l.order_id, l.direction, o.order_no, l.carrier, l.tracking_no, l.route_status, l.abnormal_flag, l.route_available, l.route_provider, l.route_message, l.route_query_time, o.recipient_phone, case when l.direction = 2 then w.address else o.recipient_address end as destination_address from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order l inner join ry_business.ry_rental_order o on o.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and o.member_id = l.member_id and o.order_id = l.order_id and o.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_warehouse w on w.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and w.member_id = l.member_id and w.warehouse_id = coalesce(l.warehouse_id, case when l.direction = 2 then o.return_warehouse_id else o.warehouse_id end) and w.is_delete = 0 where l.is_delete = 0 and l.direction in (1, 2) and l.tracking_no is not null and trim(l.tracking_no) <> '' and coalesce(l.route_status, 0) not in (2, 4) and (l.route_query_time is null or l.route_query_time <= date_sub(now(), interval 6 hour)) order by l.route_query_time is not null, l.route_query_time, l.logistics_id limit #{limit}

select l.logistics_id, l.tenant_id, l.member_id, l.order_id, l.direction, o.order_no, l.carrier, l.tracking_no, l.route_status, l.abnormal_flag, l.route_available, l.route_provider, l.route_message, l.route_query_time, o.recipient_phone, case when l.direction = 2 then w.address else o.recipient_address end as destination_address from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order l inner join ry_business.ry_rental_order o on o.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and o.member_id = l.member_id and o.order_id = l.order_id and o.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_warehouse w on w.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and w.member_id = l.member_id and w.warehouse_id = coalesce(l.warehouse_id, case when l.direction = 2 then o.return_warehouse_id else o.warehouse_id end) and w.is_delete = 0 where l.logistics_id = #{logisticsId} and l.is_delete = 0 limit 1

insert into ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_route (logistics_id, tracking_no, route_status, route_desc, route_time, province, city, raw_json, create_time, is_delete) values
(#{node.logisticsId}, #{node.trackingNo}, #{node.routeStatus}, #{node.routeDesc}, #{node.routeTime}, #{node.province}, #{node.city}, nullif(trim(#{node.rawJson}), ''), now(), 0)
mapper.update: update ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order set route_status = coalesce(#{routeStatus}, 0), abnormal_flag = coalesce(#{abnormalFlag}, 0), route_available = coalesce(#{routeAvailable}, 0), route_provider = #{routeProvider}, route_message = #{routeMessage}, estimated_arrive_time = case when #{estimatedArriveTime} is not null then #{estimatedArriveTime} when coalesce(#{routeStatus}, 0) in (2, 4) then null else estimated_arrive_time end, route_query_time = now(), update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where logistics_id = #{logisticsId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and is_delete = 0

update ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order set route_status = 0, abnormal_flag = 0, route_available = 0, route_provider = null, route_message = null, estimated_arrive_time = null, route_query_time = null, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where logistics_id = #{logisticsId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and is_delete = 0
mapper.insert: insert into ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_call_log (tenant_id, member_id, order_id, logistics_id, direction, provider, carrier, tracking_no_masked, tracking_no_hash, available, provider_status, route_status, response_message, duration_ms, error_type, create_by, create_time, is_delete) values (#{record.tenantId}, #{record.memberId}, #{record.orderId}, #{record.logisticsId}, #{record.direction}, #{record.provider}, #{record.carrier}, #{record.trackingNoMasked}, #{record.trackingNoHash}, coalesce(#{record.available}, 0), #{record.providerStatus}, #{record.routeStatus}, #{record.responseMessage}, #{record.durationMs}, #{record.errorType}, #{record.operatorId}, now(), 0)
